title: Mandaluyong’s giving of hybrid SUVs to barangay chairs drew online flak

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Mandaluyong government’s distribution of at least 27 hybrid sports utility vehicles (SUVs) for its barangay chairs went viral and drew flak online as each unit carried a market price of around P1 million. According to Mandaluyong Mayor Carmelita “Menchie” Aguilar-Abalos, the distributed SUVs form part of the city’s efforts to increase the barangay’s capacity to respond to residents’ needs and deliver services more quickly. “Overdue na talaga for the barangay captains, gagamitin nila ’yang sasakyan na ’yan pang-service at pang-service nila kasi alam niyo naman ’pag barangay captain kung saan-saan sila inuutusan at nakakapunta kaya this one […]...
